concept: Credibility through completed audit work, presented as a calm, precise brand card for a smart contract audit firm.
scene: Minimal brand card on a deep navy background with a thin amber accent line beneath a large white headline. A simple abstract grove of vertical lines suggests sentinel trees alongside a small shield outline made of clean geometric strokes. No people, no code snippets, no badges.
alt_text: Brand card with navy background and amber accent line reading 'completed 12 audits', with abstract grove lines and a shield outline.
